name: g8-play-probe

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  probe:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install Playwright
        run: |
          pip install playwright
          playwright install chromium --with-deps
      - name: Probe chess play network
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/g8-test
          python3 -u g8_play_probe.py
      - name: Upload artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: g8-play-probe
          path: /tmp/g8-test/
          retention-days: 7
